snippet.title: Fedanheim - Official Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Fedanheim is a first-person psychological horror game set in a plant where living flesh is logged as worn-out equipment and where it feeds the plant. Replacing a limb is filed as scheduled maintenance.

Wishlist here: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5158890/Fedanheim/
